stem: Which statement is NOT true about a coordinate grid?

options.label: A
options.text: The vertical number line is the y-axis.

options.label: B
options.text: In a coordinate grid, the x-axis and the y-axis are perpendicular to each other.

options.label: C
options.text: The x-coordinate is the second number in an ordered pair.

options.label: D
options.text: The origin is the intersection of the x-axis and the y-axis.
